resume: A mandatory, free procedure at the town hall (mairie) of the place of birth, within 5 days. The exact documents to bring, and the family record book issued on this occasion.
aQuoiCaSert: Registering the birth creates the child's birth certificate: without it, the child has no civil status. The certificate is drawn up immediately by the civil registrar. For a first child together, the town hall also issues the family record book (livret de famille), free of charge. It is the starting point for rights with the Caf (Caisse d'allocations familiales, the family benefits office) and the Assurance Maladie (French public health insurance). After the deadline, the town hall can no longer register the birth on its own: a court decision is needed.
quiEstConcerne: The father, the second mother, or anyone who attended the birth (doctor, midwife, head of the facility).
If the mother gives birth alone in hospital, the facility registers the birth.
aSavoir: Deadline: 5 days after the birth, not counting the day of birth. If the last day falls on a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday, it is moved to the next working day.
In Guadeloupe, the general 5-day deadline applies: the extended 8-day deadline mentioned on the official page only concerns certain towns in French Guiana.
The birth is registered at the town hall of the place of birth, not necessarily the one where you live.
After the deadline, a court declaration is required, with a lawyer, before the tribunal judiciaire (judicial court). Late registration can also lead to criminal penalties.

Unmarried parents: the father must recognize the child (reconnaissance) for parentage to be established. He can do so when registering the birth or before the birth. The mother has nothing to do if her name is on the certificate.
Family record book: for a first child together, it is drawn up when the birth is registered and issued free of charge by the town hall of the place of birth, on presentation of an ID document.

etapes.titre: Get the birth certificate from the maternity unit
etapes.detail: Also ask whether the maternity unit sends the registration to the town hall itself.

Birth certificate from the maternity unit, both parents' ID documents, prenatal recognition if there is one, surname declaration signed by both parents if you make one, existing family record book, proof of address less than 3 months old if the father has not yet recognized the child. Check the deadline: 5 days.

etapes.titre: Go to the town hall of the place of birth within the deadline
etapes.detail: Civil registry office (état civil). An unmarried father who has not yet recognized the child can do so at the same time.

etapes.titre: Collect the birth certificate and the family record book
etapes.detail: Ask for several copies of the certificate: they are needed for the Caf, the Assurance Maladie and the mutuelle (top-up health insurance). For a first child together, the town hall issues the family record book.

etapes.titre: Report the birth to the Caf and the Assurance Maladie
etapes.detail: In your Caf account, under change of situation, and in your ameli account to add the child.
